# IP-01 Brief — Scope and Requirement Inventory

## Objective

Extract the complete CR-012 / FEAT34 implementation scope and build a traceable inventory of functional requirements, non-functional requirements, APIs, data concerns, acceptance criteria, exclusions, unresolved decisions, and preflight blockers.

## Authoritative inputs

- `docs/specs/CR-012-governed-line-visual-office.md`
- `gks/phase1_docs/FEAT34-GOVERNED-LINE-VISUAL-OFFICE.md`
- `docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md`
- `docs/design/visual-office-design-spec.md`
- `docs/design/visual-office-agent-office-spec.md`
- `docs/design/visual-office-frontend-execution-plan.md`
- `docs/.preflight-report.json`
- `docs/.doc-graph.json`

## Output

Write only `docs/.rwang-tasks/CR12-FEAT34/IP-01-scope-report.md`. Do not edit source documents, the progress ledger, the graph, code, schema, generated artifacts, or Git state.

## Required content

- Scope summary and explicit non-goals.
- Requirement inventory with stable local IDs `IP-REQ-001...` mapped to source sections and FEAT34 AC-01...AC-07.
- NFR and governance inventory for tenancy, RBAC, PII, audit, accessibility, performance, availability, and no-deception behavior.
- Complete endpoint/resource inventory, classifying each as frozen, proposed, blocked, or out of scope.
- Open decisions and blocker ledger, including Phase 2 promotion, RBAC amendment, `/office` permission, runtime/delivery contracts, and project preflight critical findings.
- No claim that specified endpoints or UI already exist.

## Review hard gates

Completeness, source traceability, and internal consistency must all pass.
